what: Decode-lever bundle arm C, boot 1 of 2 (ABAB: B1=s3, C1=this, B2, C2). Boot from perf-review-0924 (HEAD in git_head.txt) with IMAGE=review-e13 + DSV41_WOA_PREPACK=1 DSV41_MHC_DECODE_SPLITS=40 + the s4-promoted prefill levers DSV41_ENGRAM_WILLNEED=1 DSV41_STREAM_FEED=1, AUDIT=strict. DSV41_P2B_SRC_SORT, DSV41_DSPARK_SPARSE_MARKOV, DSV41_DENSE_DG_SMALLM stay off (s1 decisions). DECODE protocol (L.A.I.L first, before any c=2 traffic, same order as s2/s3) then C2-STRESS. Then a SEPARATE profiler boot (same env + EXTRA_ARGS --profiler-config) for one two-rank profile window, so the measured arm carries no profiler flag.

profile.how: Separate boot (the flag's idle steady-state cost is not measured, and the active profiler adds ~3-5 ms/step per trace3 ATTRIBUTION.md, so it was kept out of the measured boot): same env + EXTRA_ARGS='--profiler-config {"profiler":"torch","torch_profiler_dir":"/tmp/dsv41-traces"}'. Start 22:04:00Z, run.sh exit 22:13:44Z; audit ok; 43/43 woa packed both ranks; smoke 323 + Red (vision again ~14 s = same JIT). tools/profile_window.sh: warmup, start_profile, one 512-token L.A.I.L stream (wall 14.94 s), stop_profile. The stop_profile curl timed out at 120 s (rc 28, set -e ended the script) but 'Profiler stopped successfully' was logged and both ranks' traces were complete; docker cp was done by hand before ./stop.sh. MemAvail on spark1 fell to 2.2 GiB after the export (spark2 8.2 GiB); stop.sh rc 0 immediately after cp.
